product_description_excerpt: Sonia is an AI therapist that conducts entire therapy sessions both by voice and text via a phone app. 70 million Americans who struggle with their mental health can now access therapy for $200 per year instead of $200 per session. Founded by a team of MIT researchers who published 9 papers on AI at conferences like NeurIPS.
